Tara: Quick heads-up 1 opened a tiny PR to standardize the quota examples and add a short migration note for the pricing copy. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/811

Maya: For dashboards, I added a variable ${DS_BILLING} instead of hardcoding the datasource. Also added a tiny panel that shows meter.consumption vs meter.request_count.

Tara: I like that. We need to pick the header name and mention older header aliases in migration. Can someone add a 1-line migration table?
Jordi: I'll add a mapping: `x-rw-usage` -> `x-rw-billing-mode` (new). I'll also add a comment for SDK PR when it's created.
Maya: Small nit: link-check flagged an old anchor `/pricing#tiers`. I've added a redirect `/pricing -> /billing` and updated internal refs in the PR.
Ethan: Add a 429 handling blurb too: short pseudo-code (3 retries, full jitter). Keeps support tickets down.
